notes: FEATURES lists operating temperature 0°C to 85°C; Case Operating Temperature in II, VI, and IX DDM is 0°C to 70°C. Absolute Maximum Ratings Case Operating Temperature TOP is 0°C to 70°C. Fiber reach is specified in meters (e.g. 100 m OM4/M5F at 28.05 Gb/s, 70 m OM3/M5E, 20 m OM2/M5 at 28.05 Gb/s; additional lengths at 8.5 and 14.025 Gb/s in Section V). Supply current Icc max 290 mA; note 1 states total power dissipation could exceed 1 W during link establishment below 25°C case temperature—no nominal power consumption in Watts given. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 10^-12 BER for 8.5 and 14.025 Gb/s; for 32GFC with FEC, sensitivity at 10^-6 BER per optical table note 6. RxMAX 2 dBm is Receiver Optical Modulation Amplitude maximum. Stress receiver sensitivity wavelength range λC 770–860 nm. Spectral width (RMS) max 0.57 nm at 28.05 Gb/s. RIN max -129 dB/Hz at 28.05 Gb/s and -128 dB/Hz at 14.025 and 8.5 Gb/s. TWDP max 4.3 dB at 8.5 Gb/s; VECPQ max 2.56 dB at 14.025 Gb/s and 3.13 dB at 28.05 Gb/s—not mapped to penalty schema without paired penalized values and conditions.
